metaDescription: Order custom direct to film sports gear for your team or event. Vibrant, durable prints on bulk orders. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film (DTF) printing on sports gear delivers vibrant, full-color designs that stand up to repeated wear and washing. Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF allows for intricate details and gradients without setup fees, making it ideal for small to medium runs of custom jerseys, hats, and bags. Whether you are outfitting a corporate softball league or branding gear for a charity 5K, DTF transfers bond securely to polyester, nylon, and cotton blends — common materials in athletic apparel.
